hero.title: Welcome back…
hero.lede: We like music that crackles, movies with a fuzzy border, games that take an hour to load and then crash. In fact, we love the old stuff so much, we created a magazine about it!

latest.lede: Popular Retro lands with a brand-new issue and for the first time, we're also available in print! A massive retrospective of the Philips CD-i, and the Sinclair ZX81 turns 40.

special.title: Special Edition #1
special.lede: Select cuts of issues one to four of Popular Retro plus issue five, in one beautiful hardback book.
special.text: Extensive coverage of THEC64, THEVIC20 and THEC64 Mini. Also, nostalgic food, toys and culture from yesteryear, from ice lollies to Top Trumps.
special.gap: Amazon lists it as unavailable. Still on sale?

backIssues.title: Back issues
backIssues.text: Issues one to five began as free digital editions, and the best of them now live on in Special Edition #1.

writers.title: Popular Retro needs you
writers.lede: Are you a writer, do you have a passion for retro? Join our family of creators bringing quality retro content to a worldwide audience.

newsletter.title: Hear about the next issue first
newsletter.text: No spam, no junk and no nonsense. We'll let you know about the next issue only. Trust us, we hate junk mail!
